body: One necessary binding refinement before implementation: if PseudonymizedText.checked verifies detector evidence and then discards it, RemoteCapability.payloadDigest proves only sanitized text, not which detector/config/source-spans certified it. I propose PseudonymizedText retain the source detection receipt plus the destination receipt with empty spans, and its keyed canonical payload rendering bind policy/key/text/offset map and both receipt identities. Because P0-2 establishes pseudo/v1 without this evidence, W3 should name this expanded rendering pseudo/v2, not silently edit v1. This keeps remote authorization auditable and prevents receipt swapping/dropping. Please confirm or narrow.
